properties.note: Inventory of Abandoned Mine Lands. kind='site' rows are the site record; kind='feature' rows are individual field-mapped openings, dumps, water bodies and structures, and their iaml_id is the source featureID ('<site>-<n>'). Features inherit mining_district and county from their parent site.

properties.name: Red Mountain
properties.production: Conflicting reports regarding production at mill. Most sources state "no production." Huntting (1956) reports production in 1930, 1935, 10,000 tons 1936, 5,825 tons 1937, 12 tons 1940.

properties.name: Red Mountain
properties.feature_description: Mill site and camp. Originally >30 buildings including mill, sawmill, powerhouse, store, residences. Fewer than 6 structures remain. Mill dismantled and sold for scrap in 1946. No tailings found in area between site of mill building and Chiwawa River. Sediment examined is fine sandy silt with pebbles, some cobbles. Cobbles more abundant at banks of Chiwawa River. Nothing appeared to be tailings. Aqueduct reported here. Observed old riveted spiral iron pipe from which sound of rushing water eminated.

properties.name: Red Mountain
properties.feature_description: "Trinity Tunnel" main haul adit. Reported length 11,000ft. Open. Ineffective wood frame and plywood closure. Draining clear water. Large WRD (400ft x 350ft x 60ft slope), barren of mineralization.

properties.name: Red Mountain
properties.feature_description: "St. Francis Tunnel" caved adit. WRD (40ft x 500ft x 60ft slope) eroding into Phelps Creek.

properties.name: Red Mountain
properties.feature_description: 1960's era adit, 6ft diameter culvert at portal extends into hillside keeping portal open.  Evidence of human entry despite locked, hinged steel grating closure. Timbered, rails. Discharge approx 10gpm flows into Phelps Creek. WRD eroding into Phelps Creek (see 1002-3).

Also dry small stream bed entering adit portal area from SW. Discharge at time of visit about1gpm. Culver Gulch stream eroding toe of WRD. Adit open, standing water, accessed by people, length >100ft. Water sample W-B2 at toe of WRD. Water sample W-B3 at adit portal (see feature record 1003-21).

properties.name: Blewett Camp
properties.feature_description: Adit, open, curved, contains water, WRD (300ft x 60ft x 40ft slope) in streambed reworked by stream and/or bulldozer, pelton wheel lies on N slope of gulch near here. Water impounded, depth and extent unknown. Water sample W-B4.

properties.name: Blewett Camp
properties.feature_description: "Tunnel no. 9" (Pole Pick tunnel), mostly caved, filled, sluffing highbank above. 2 shacks (intact) on skids contain tools and materials. Equipment lying on WRD includes: 1 compressed air locomotive engine, 1 Ingersol Rand compressor, 2 empty 400gal fuel tanks, 2 empty air tanks, 2 ore cars, 1 loader, scrap matal, various pipe, claim marker. Pipe in gully discharging, presumably from adit. Water sampled W-B5.

properties.name: Lone Star and Washington
properties.production: Most recent production inn 1970s shipped ore to Canada. Surface Mining Rec. Permit 11523.

properties.name: Lone Star and Washington
properties.feature_description: Pit. Benched, low angle walls. Approx 500ft x 800ft x 100ft deep. Some revegetation on walls and floor. Abundant approx 12 year old fir trees on  steep slopes (apparently of waste rock) outside pit.

properties.name: Lone Star and Washington
properties.feature_description: Pond nearly devoid of life except for insects, very few underwater plants where water enters from upper pond. Cattle apparently drink here. Sample collected from this pond at shore opposite where water enters from upper pond. Discharge into pond at about10 gpm, no outlet.

properties.name: Lone Star and Washington
properties.feature_description: Pond, abundant life. Discharges into lower pond (1008-2) at about10 gpm. Bed color orange with much green and green-grey algae. Third (smaller) pond (approx 30ft diameter, 1ft deep), brackish with much vegetation. Thick blackish algae on bottom, green algae, cattails. Other adjacent pools (small, deep). Water may be coming to surface here. Possibly obliterated adit here. Only evidence observed is two sections of narrow gage rail and 3 drill holes.

Machinery apparently abandoned on site. Tailings sampled.

properties.name: Republic
properties.production: Mill foundations and tailings remain on hill over looking Granite Creek 2000ft E of mine workings and 3600ft S of center of town of Republic. This mill presumably processed ore from many sites. There were concentrating mills at at least two locations near Republic around 1900. This mill is thought to be the Republic Reduction Company mill built in 1899-1900 (Photo DSCN1860.jpg).

properties.feature_description: Republic Reduction Company mill site. Total tailings: approx 2 acres, 600x200ft, at creek bank from 9cm to 15ft thick, estimate 10,000 cu yds. Three tailings samples collected from stream bank.

properties.name: Republic

Opening had been filled, but hole has re-opened (fill has subsided). Stope extends approx 500ft horizontally and to unknown depth. It is suggested that fill material may continue to subside, as it has near the N end (photo https://fortress.wa.gov/dnr/geologydata/inactive_abandoned_mines/image_1894.jpg). properties.name: Apex
properties.production: Mill site included gravity concentrating tables and lower tramway terminal only. Less than 100 tons ore processed on site. Total production $300,000.

properties.name: Apex
properties.feature_description: Adit 2: open, length 150ft (literature), water pouring in from above, water standing approx 1ft deep, 55gal drum inside portal. WRD 20ft x 50ft x 125ft. Collapsed wooden structure served as landing.

properties.name: Apex
properties.feature_description: Adit 3: partly open, reported length 500ft., timbered collar. Portal partly filled with colluvium. Approx 2gpm water discharge across dump then infiltrates. WRD (35ft x 40ft x 150ft slope) volume approx 500 cu yd.

properties.name: Apex
properties.feature_description: Site of historic tram terminal, snow shed, bunkhouse and adit. Includes: Adit 4 in precipitious Milwaukee Ck canyon, below lake. Adit is open, large blocks caving from near portal. Minor water standing on floor. Present opening driven approx 1985, failed to intersect historic adit. Historic adit portal caved, directly above cribbing in creek. Historic adit leads to stopes under lake. Tram terminal remnants collapsed and burned. Path between adit and WRD (area of former snowshed) is partly caved. Large diameter culvert section lying on iron stained WRD (50ft x 30ft x 80ft slope) contains bunkbed and wood stove.

properties.name: Apex
properties.feature_description: Remnants of historic lower tram terminal and mill site. Mill consisted of gravity concentrating tables only. Less than 100 tons ore processed. Site includes remains of engine block, pelton wheel, electrical motor/generator, some deteriorating timbers. Site burned. No structure standing.  <100cu yds iron stained gravel and sand size waste rock. Small stream flows through site and into Money Creek. Creek contains thick green algae, orange bed.

properties.name: Roy and Barnum McDonnell
properties.production: Different retorts operated at different times in different areas of the site. 300 ton/day at mouth of BM6 haul tunnel never used.

properties.name: Roy and Barnum McDonnell
properties.feature_description: BM1 adit, caved.

properties.name: Roy and Barnum McDonnell
properties.feature_description: BM2 adit, portal caved. Subsidence on centerline of adit: 50ft diameter above portal and 10ft diameter, 26ft deep vertical opening (on road).

properties.name: Roy and Barnum McDonnell
properties.feature_description: Barnum McDonnell No. 4 adit, caved. Small WRD bisected by unnamed intermittent stream. Water sample W-BM4 taken from stream.

properties.name: Roy and Barnum McDonnell
properties.feature_description: Site of BM6 haulage adit.   Adit reported to be 1400ft. Adit is obliterated. Water drains through 36 inch culvert under Davis Lake Rd at reported adit location.

properties.name: Roy and Barnum McDonnell
properties.feature_description: Remains of 300 ton/day mill. Concrete skeletal structure 50ft S of BM6 haul tunnel. Few cu yd pile of fine grain material (sample S-Roy-Const) and water impounded inside structure. Mill never produced. Water (see 1026a-5 entry) flowing around structure. Adjacent sub-grade concrete foundation/sump presents fall hazard.

properties.name: Roy and Barnum McDonnell
properties.feature_description: R1, water impound in adit. 1 inch PVC pipe with valve supplies domestic water. Portal blocked by colluvium except 1x3ft opening at top. Thick vegetation. Water sample W-Roy1 at adit.

properties.name: Roy and Barnum McDonnell
properties.feature_description: Roy No. 5, caved adit, water flowing down highwall and across small WRD, evidence of retort (fire bricks, oxidized soil) at WRD. Water samples: W-Roy5 (at adit), this record, and W-Roy5-1 (below dump), record 1026a-10.

properties.name: Roy and Barnum McDonnell
properties.feature_description: Open adit adjacent to apparently completely caved adit ("Parmenter Tunnel"?). Rotted timbers inside. Sandstone slab overhangs entrance. Reported length 60ft. Reported to have been dug by front-end loader in early 1960s. WRD (12ft x 50ft x 60ft slope).

properties.name: Bodie
properties.production: Amalgamation-cyanide and flotation.

properties.name: Bodie
properties.feature_description: Mill site: Two 1" diameter cables extend through the air from top of steep slope above mill site to horizontal area of mill site. Observed mill building ruins include concrete footings only.

properties.name: Bodie
properties.feature_description: Structure 100' S of mill site (1028-10). Old, long abandoned house w/ chimney, partly crushed by fallen tree

properties.name: Bodie
properties.feature_description: Tailings, in floodplain between mill site (1028-10) and Toroda creek and extending 1500 ft along Torada Creek N of mill site. Mostly covered with grass, some shrubs and trees. Torada Creek is actively eroding tailings for 1000ft along perimeter of dump. Raforth sampled water here (2000). Torada creek flows at a few thousand gpm.Tailings sampled.

properties.name: Bodie
properties.feature_description: Adit, open, short. On abandoned road SE of mill site (1028-10). WRD approx 30ft x 50ft x 60ft slope.

properties.name: Bodie
properties.feature_description: Adit, open, bald-headed, narrow, significant air flow. Length: beyond flashlight beam. Located above mill site (1028-10) at upper end of tram cables. Three small WRD: 50ft x 40ft x 80ft slope; 10ft x 20ft x 80ft slope; 20ft x 30ft x 80ft slope. Log building adjacent to adit, partly caved roof, served as shop, contains forge ruins, pneumatic drill parts.

properties.name: Bodie
properties.feature_description: Adit, portal mostly closed by sluffing. 12x6" opening exhausting cold air. Located in ravine, approx 140 ft above 1028-5. 30ft x 40ft x 60ft slope WRD with natural revegetation.

properties.name: Bodie
properties.feature_description: Stope, open, unstable edges, with associated subsidence. Located at top of bluff. Extends 420 ft, trends approx N30E, 4 - 10 ft wide, >100 ft deep. Plunges at 74 degrees below horizontal.

properties.name: Bodie
properties.feature_description: Adit, entrance opening 36"x18"; partly filled; hinged wooden door inside. Hasp on wooden door cut with bolt cutters. Located approx 75 ft SSW of S end of open stope (1028-7). Adjacent collapsing wooden structure.

properties.name: Bodie
properties.feature_description: Adit, partly caved inside; entrance partly filled; wooden doorway partly covered. Located approx 85 ft W of S end of open stope (1028-7). 20ft x 40ft x 80ft slope WRD. Dry; sparse, normal vegetation.

properties.name: Alder
properties.production: Mill site lies at 1840ft approx 1/2 mile SSE from center of town of Twisp. 1939-1941: "ore and concentrates in excess of $400,000 were produced and shipped to the ASARCO smelter in Tacoma" (Lucas 1976). 1950: 300 ton/day selected flotation mill. Produced full time until May 1953.

properties.name: Alder mine
properties.feature_description: Adit with 65 degrees inclined shaft at portal, both unknown length/depth. Adit bears 235 degrees, Entrance partly blocked with timbers, 6ft high, 5ft wide, easily entered, plenty of evidence of human use. One rail observed inside adit, no air flow noted, Portal timbers support gravel, sand, shotrock at collar of incline. Timbers of unknown condition. One must stand on timber supported material to approach portal. This feature located at bottom, E side, of pit bounded on NW by highwall 50ft high, 250ft long, trending 170 degrees. Opposite side of pit is highwall immediately above this opening (40ft high, 90 degrees to 95 degrees over vertical). Dry. Highwalls have crumbly edges. Scree slope of long highwall sparsely vegetated with few small shrubs.

properties.name: Alder mine
properties.feature_description: WRD. Alder WRD is most prominent feature of site. Mostly void of vegetation. Dry, but gullied and rilled. Adit (Feature 1030-3) discharges to gully down WRD slope. Estimated 100ft length x 650ft wide, 200ft slope length at 37 degrees, Est 50,000 cu yds. Horizontal area at elev 3560ft.

properties.name: Alder mine
properties.feature_description: Adit, partly caved portal, bears 60 degrees. Accessible entrance, 3ft high x 5ft wide opening. Length unknown. Distinct smell eminating from adit. Exhaust <2mph. Water discharge <1gpm, and standing approx 10 inches deep inside portal. Water clear with white to yellow-white and blue-green ppt. Water sample "Alder Upper" collected here. Some vegetation: fir, willow, grass, algae, and stressed looking pine. WRD (see 1030-2).

properties.name: Alder mine
properties.feature_description: Adit, partly caved portal, bears 110 degrees. 20 inch high x 4ft wide opening. Length unknown. Water discharge 3-5 gpm, and standing approx 1ft deep inside portal. Discharge fills pond 25ft x15ft x 1ft deep. Water clear, pond bed orange, area (30ft long) of flow between adit and pond covered with thick green to very dark green algae. PVC pipes drain pond overflow down face of WRD. WRD (50ft x 200ft wide x 100ft slope at 38 degrees), sampled. Water sampled "Alder Lower" from pond, elevated metals.

properties.name: Alder mine
properties.feature_description: Mine camp area, grass clearing with some scattered remains of machinery, vehicles. BMI sampled in Alder creek here.

properties.name: Alder mine
properties.feature_description: Small, deep vertical hole at side of road (possible caved or subsidence feature?). Naturally re-vegetated prospect trench/explored area immediately up-hill.

properties.name: Arlington
properties.production: Ore concentrated at Washington Reduction Company mill at Ruby City prior to 1893. In 1936 a 50 ton flotation mill was constructed near portal of main adit.

properties.name: Arlington
properties.feature_description: Surface excavation, obliterated lower adit portal. Excavated area approx 200ft x 200ft x 50ft deep in hill side. Approx 5gpm discharge, orange stained bed. Waste rock area appears to be colluvium, no shotrock observed.

properties.name: Arlington
properties.feature_description: Upper adit, open, bears 105 degrees. Damp mud on floor, appears to impound 4 inches water in past. Three WRDs: 1) 25ft x 190ft x 50ft slope, yellow-orange, fine to cobble size. 2) 60ft x 15ft x 30ft slope, white to yellow to yellow-orange angular qtz cobbles. 3) 30ft x 20ft x 25ft slope, qtz cobbles and boulders form retaining wall.

properties.name: Ruby
properties.production: Total production about 12,100 tons yielding 151,000 oz. Ag.  1920: Pyragyrite Mining Co. built 75 ton flotation mill, operated until 1923.

properties.name: Ruby
properties.feature_description: Mill building (one of 6 structures observed on site), some interior walls removed, portions not level or plumb, most equipment removed. Interior includes vertical iron cylinder, concrete footings,

properties.name: Ruby
properties.feature_description: Adit, open, intact timbers, water standing about4inches deep, discharging water about5gpm, exhaust forming mist at portal, large WRD (approx 50ft x 200ft x 40ft slope). Water sample (RUBY). Structures on WRD include blacksmiths shop, shed. Blacksmiths shop includes footings, hood and chimney (photo 1952). Power recently run to this building, but meter and equipment removed or destroyed.

properties.name: Bella May
properties.production: 1923-1924, 18 carloads hand sorted galena ore sent to railroad at Metaline Falls. Previous to 1923, concentrating mill operated on site. Since 1937, ore hauled through the "new adit" (Metaline) and trucked to Grandview Mill, concentrates shipped by rail to American Zinc Co's smelter in East St. Louis (Jenkins 1924, pp 64-65; Park and Cannon 1943, pp 65-67; Dings 1965, p 86). (See also Metaline Mining and Leasing entry.)

properties.name: Bella May
properties.feature_description: Lower adit 1, partly caved portal, exhausting. Inside, floor drops into large cavern, Dry. Remnants of hinged door on portal.

properties.name: Bella May

properties.name: Bella May
properties.feature_description: Upper feature 1, open adit, shaft, stopes, interconnected. Adit dimensions: 5x5x30ft long, bears 260 degrees, portal drops 12ft into open stope. Stoped out areas to left and right, on a line bearing 175 degrees. Left opening widens (about12ft) and plunges (room about20ft tall). Right opening drops vertically another 12ft (24ft total observed depth, 6x5ft wide). Dry. WRD 30l x 100w x 30ft length.

properties.name: Bella May

properties.name: Grandview
properties.production: greater than 1,254,000 tons  (Huntting, 1956)

properties.name: Pend Oreille West Side Workings
properties.production: 1930: small flotation mill built [possibly the ruins 2700ft up Flume Cr from Pend Oreille River]. 1937: 600 ton/day flotation mill completed [on Flume Cr canyon, immediately above Pend Oreille River]. 1950 milling moved to east side of river, West side mill used periodically until 1952.

properties.name: Pend Oreille West Side Workings
properties.feature_description: Pend Oreille 1937 mill site. Ruins include: 1) 24ft diameter concrete ore hopper/feeder base with <100cu yds sand - gravel (ore?) and few bags ZnSO4 [Photo 2506]. 2) 24ft diameter foundation with 45ft dia pile 1-2 ft high sand - gravel (ore?). 3) two machinery footings (ball mills?) [photos 2515-2518]. Mill buildings burned. Debris, waste rock cast into Flume Creek canyon. No sign of tailings. Dry.

properties.name: Pend Oreille West Side Workings
properties.feature_description: Adit, open, 8ft high, 10ft wide, 20ft length, on 11 degrees incline, bears 300 degrees, purposely made to be a sump? 7x4ft steel tank, empty; water line shows adit fills to 12ft from floor. Dry.

properties.name: Pend Oreille West Side Workings
properties.feature_description: "300 Level Adit"?, open, partly caved portal, 3x1ft opening, bears 310 degrees, immediately on N side trestle. No air flow. Waste rock presumably cast into canyon.

properties.name: Pend Oreille West Side Workings
properties.feature_description: "West Side Main Shaft," filled, area bulldozed. Wood, metal debris pushed E. Waste rock in area of shaft 150x50ft. WRD 20x50ft with150ft face at canyon edge. Presumably much waste rock dumped into Flume Creek in past.

properties.name: Pend Oreille West Side Workings
properties.feature_description: 1937 mill site ruins. Concrete block building containing est 100 50lb deteriorating paper bags of ZnSO4, (metallic Zn 35percent); Roof appears intact, floor stained green, metal door open. Dry.

properties.name: Pend Oreille West Side Workings
properties.feature_description: 1937 mill site ruins. Log cabin ruins, two 55gal drums empty.

properties.name: Pend Oreille West Side Workings
properties.feature_description: Pend Oreille mill site (1930?, 1937 - early 1950s) ruins. Trestle ruins over Flume Cr canyon, 6" steel pipe spans chasm. Tailings possibly discharged into Flume Creek.

properties.name: Pend Oreille West Side Workings
properties.feature_description: Mill site ruins. Sullivan mill or Pend Oreille 1930 mill? Includes: Five distinct tailings piles (<50cu yds each), concrete footings. Road cuts through site. Flume Creek cuts through lower tailings area. Most tailings presumably cast into creek.

properties.name: Pend Oreille West Side Workings
properties.feature_description: Adit, caved, rails, 40x20x30ft WRD.

properties.name: Pend Oreille West Side Workings
properties.feature_description: Sullivan glory hole 120ft dia, 70ft deep, vertical walls, further workings seen at bottom (shaft, filled? and drifts to NNW).  Appears dry.

properties.name: Pend Oreille West Side Workings
properties.feature_description: Open pit, 60x100ft with 50ft vertical highwall, abandoned car, empty rusty barrel. Dry. "Josephine Glory Hole"?

properties.name: Pend Oreille West Side Workings
properties.feature_description: Open pit, adit, shaft/stope. "Josephine Glory Hole"? Pit/waste rock area 180x100ft with 40ft vertical highwall. Adit and shaft/stope in NW corner. Adit portal mostly filled with earth berm, air exhausting, wood rat inside, formerly rubber tired vehicle sized opening, bears 295 degrees. Adjacent shaft/stope: overhanging highwall 60ft, horizontal extent: 30x40ft, stope excavated to left and right. Household trash in pit. Dry.

properties.name: Metaline Mining and Leasing
properties.production: Zn-Pb ores trucked to flotation mill at Grandview Mine, flotation concentrates shipped to St. Louis. 410,000 tons through 1947.

properties.name: Metaline Mining and Leasing
properties.feature_description: MML Haul Adit, open, welded 1/2 inch rebar grating appears effective in preventing human entry, but could be bent to allow entry, water draining at approx 20gpm, evidence of seasonal higher flows. Portal area scoured to bedrock. Volume of waste rock removed by adit drainage: approx 50x40x50ft. Water flows approx 60ft into Pend Oreille river. properties.name: Dutch Miller
properties.feature_description: Main adit, open, water impound and discharge. Chalcopyrite boulders to 750cm length caved from portal ceiling. Portal lies on vein. Steel wheelbarrow at portal extremely rusted. Water sampled here (Dutch Miller no. W-CH1). Literature locates a flooded 100ft shaft (main shaft or no. 1 shaft, Stephens photograph 10 and others) immediately in front of this adit. At time of this visit, however, area in front of adit is covered with 3 - 6ft compact snow (neve). As the adit is an attraction, this shaft may pose a significant hazard when the snow melts to where it no longer can support the weight of a person standing on the shaft or walking over the shaft toward the adit. WRD between portal and largest of the Chain Lakes includes much high grade ore. Much iron staining along lake shorelines and in streams between lakes. "Slusher" bucket and Ingersol Rand hydraulic winch near feature.
